in_sanskrit.name: फाल्गुनी
in_sanskrit.meaning: Born in the Month of Phalguna
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Phalguna is the 11th month in the Hindu lunar calendar. It corresponds to February-March in the Gregorian calendar.

in_marathi.name: Falguni
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Born in Spring
in_marathi.long_meaning: Falguni हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from Sanskrit word 'Falguna', it means 'born in spring' or 'the month of spring'.

in_bengali.name: Falguni
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Born in Spring
in_bengali.long_meaning: Falguni একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from Sanskrit word 'Falguna', it means 'born in spring' or 'the month of spring'.
